items.subject: daily pipeline did not run on 2026-09-15 or 2026-09-16
evidence: RE-MEASURED 2026-09-25: grocery/out/logs/capture-run-daily-<date>.log exists for every day 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-25 (9 of 9) and is still missing for 09-15 and 09-16; 'TC Grocery Daily Capture 0800' LastRunTime 2026-09-25 14:00:02, LastTaskResult 0, WakeToRun True, StartWhenAvailable True

System log 2026-09-15 and 09-16: Power-Troubleshooter 1 (wake) at 07:59:36, Kernel-Power 107 (resume) at 08:02:03, Kernel-Power 42 (sleep) at 08:02:01; same pair at 06:59:36 / 07:02:02 for the 07:00 task; alert-log.txt holds 0 lines written on either day
Kernel-Power 42 per day since 2026-09-01: 09-01 1, 09-15 3, 09-16 2, 09-21 1; no sleep on any day since 09-17 but 09-21, so the box being awake is why 9 of 9 days ran, not a fix

.github/workflows/heartbeat.yml is 'on: { workflow_dispatch: {} }' (dispatch-only), and grocery/health-heartbeat.ps1 runs on the same sleeping box, so no independent watcher could page on a day the box slept
items.root_cause: A scheduled run on this box is woken by WakeToRun but nothing holds the machine awake while it runs, so Windows' unattended idle timeout (about 2 minutes after a wake with no user) puts it back to sleep mid-run; every scheduled Kind (ad, daily, the rest) was one idle timeout from being cut off after a wake, and the only absence watcher off the box (heartbeat.yml) is dispatch-only.

surface_fix.what: none for the two missed days: their boards were never built and the next days' runs rebuilt the board

root_fix.what: hold a system-required power request for the life of every capture-run
root_fix.exact_change: new lib/keep-awake.ps1: Enter-TcKeepAwake calls kernel32 SetThreadExecutionState(ES_CONTINUOUS | ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED), returns {ok, previous, why} and never throws; Exit-TcKeepAwake clears it. capture-run.ps1 dot-sources it and calls Enter-TcKeepAwake before it asks for Global\tc-capture-run, printing 'keep-awake: held|NOT held'. Windows drops the request when the process ends, so a dead run never pins the box awake.

items.leaves_open: the absence of a run is still watched only from the box itself: heartbeat.yml is dispatch-only, so a box that is OFF (not asleep) or a wake timer that never fires still produces no page until the box is back; 2 occurrences (09-15, 09-16) in the 14 days before this fix, both the sleep shape this fix closes, 0 of the off shape

blast_radius.measured_by: not a matching rule: measured over capture-run's own start. The call sits before the run lock and changes no file, no row and no exit code; a refused request prints 'NOT held' and the run goes on exactly as before. Real test-capture-run-sync.ps1 (drives capture-run in throwaway repos) 49 of 49, exit 0
blast_radius.risk: the box can no longer idle-sleep while a capture-run is live (up to the task's own 2h limit); it sleeps normally once the run exits

items.freshness: measured 2026-09-25 ~19:10 against the System event log, grocery/out/logs of the main checkout and Get-ScheduledTask on this box

proof.must_fire_case: Enter-TcKeepAwake then a read-back through SetThreadExecutionState: the flags held include ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED and ES_CONTINUOUS (founding bug: the 08:00 run re-slept 2.5 min after its wake); and capture-run.ps1 calls Enter-TcKeepAwake before it creates Global\tc-capture-run
proof.clean_twin: Exit-TcKeepAwake leaves ES_CONTINUOUS alone with no system-required bit, and asking twice holds the same flags (idempotent)

items.rollback: revert the capture-run.ps1 hunk and delete lib/keep-awake.ps1; nothing on disk depends on it
items.resolution_note: The two missed days were the box sleeping: the 08:00 WakeToRun timer woke it at 07:59:36 and the unattended idle timeout re-slept it at 08:02:01 on both 09-15 and 09-16, before capture-run logged. 9 of 9 days since have run only because the box stayed awake. capture-run now holds ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED for its whole run (lib/keep-awake.ps1).
items.premise_check: the premise (no run on 09-15/16, no page) holds: logs absent for both days, alert-log silent both days, the heartbeat that would page runs on the same box

items.subject: walmart ruling-term proof can be erased by a same-day rebuild
evidence: RE-MEASURED 2026-09-25: of the 9 tracked walmart-regular files dated 2026-09-12 onward, every one has 1 committed version (git log per file), so 0 occurrences

build-walmart-deals.ps1 wrote walmart-regular-<Date>.json whole from one capture (ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content), and Get-WalmartRulingOwed (capture-policy-lib.ps1) proves a term only from found_by_term of rows in that file

reproduced with the real builder in this worktree: built 2026-09-24 from its full capture (35 distinct found_by_term), then from a 40-line cut of it (1 term): before the fix the second file would hold 1 of 35; after it, 1 fresh + 34 proof_terms_carried, covering all 35
items.root_cause: A builder that owns a dated file rewrites it whole from one capture while a downstream reader treats that file's contents as a durable receipt, so a same-date rerun silently withdraws evidence the first run earned (the same shape 818b3e fixed for Baker's ad-term receipts).

surface_fix.what: none: 0 occurrences, no file to repair

root_fix.what: a same-date rebuild carries the replaced file's proof terms, and the owed reader counts them
root_fix.exact_change: capture-policy-lib: Get-WalmartSameDayProofCarry returns the replaced file's found_by_term plus its own proof_terms_carried, less this build's terms, only when week_of matches and both sources name the same storeId; Get-WalmartRulingOwed adds a file's proof_terms_carried to proven (under the same sanctioned-store stamp check). build-walmart-deals: computes the source once, calls the carry before writing and writes proof_terms_carried (terms only, never rows).

items.leaves_open: nothing (the other writer, import-walmart-batch.ps1:599-603, edits the loaded document in place and so keeps proof_terms_carried and every other top-level field)

blast_radius.measured_by: not a matching rule: rows are untouched (the carry is a top-level list of terms), so no board cell can move; measured by the real two-build run above and by Get-WalmartRulingOwed over a fixture out dir
blast_radius.risk: a term carried from an earlier same-day build at the same store stays proven; a build at another storeId, another week_of or with no recorded store carries nothing

proof.clean_twin: a third build that found bread carries [bacon, rice] forward (the carried set chains); MUST NOT FIRE: storeId 3153, week_of 2026-09-25 and a -WaiveMissingStoreLine source each carry nothing
